[name="Mon3tr"]（急切的嘶吼）
[delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]它很不喜欢，看到别的自己。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]凯尔希……不灭之人。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]你还记得你最初的模样吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]“不灭之人”是一部分人对我的想象和误解。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]时间同样会在我身上留下痕迹。最初的那个名为“凯尔希”的个体，早就湮灭在了黄沙之中。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]但你还是你自己。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]你在特蕾西娅身边重生的时候，我们也在注视着你。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]你与上一个你，从样貌到性格，都有所不同。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]我们习惯于为了生存而不断变化。
[name="Mon3tr？"]在萨卡兹之中，变形者集群也很特殊。我们曾以为，你与我们是相似的。
[name="Mon3tr？"]我们认识很多个“凯尔希”，就如同凯尔希认识很多个我们。
[name="Mon3tr？"]然而变形者从来都是集群。每一个变形者都是我们感受这个世界的接收器。
[name="Mon3tr？"]而“凯尔希”不同。每一个凯尔希都是你自己。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]我确实这么认为。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]为什么？
[name="Mon3tr？"]是记忆的传承令你如此坚持吗？记忆明明很容易就能被篡改和灌输。我们知道，许多长生者都用过类似手段。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]以这种形式达成的“永生”与谎言无异。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]那么，难道是某种职责……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]我不否认，从降生那一刻开始，我的生命就与职责相绑定。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]回顾过往，我不认为……我算是真正“活着”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]构成你身体的物质已经全部被更换过。继承自前代个体的记忆同样并不可靠。被强加的使命未必属于你自己。
[name="Mon3tr？"]凯尔希，这一万多年来，是什么令你坚信，你始终如一？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]一个名字。
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",bstart=0,bend=0.8,focus="m")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]一个独有的称呼或者代号？很多缺乏关爱的萨卡兹会在意。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]这个名字，意味着很多。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]给予我名字的人，还有我在意的人，正身处险境，现在并不是我们交谈的良机。
[dialog]
[Charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_humanchange", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=2)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="变形者集群"]我们想不到，连你也如此感性。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]Mon3tr。
[dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[playsound(key="$char_Mon3tr",volume=0.5)]
[delay(time=1)]
[name="Mon3tr"]（兴奋的嚎叫）

[name="闪灵"]……
[name="夜莺"]“丽兹”，我一直很喜欢你为我取的这个名字。
[name="夜莺"]不要逃开我独自承担一切，我们约定好了要共同面对——
[charslot]

[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n当闪灵回过神，那只手已经从她的衣袖间悄然滑落。",block = true)]

[delay(time=1)]

[delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]一场悲剧，但结局总是固定的。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]你杀死我，令你成为下一段血脉的温床，或是，你眼睁睁看着我带走她，而后你溺死在懊悔之中。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]都是一样的，姐姐。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="萨卢斯"]首领，我们得撤退了！
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m",afrom=0,ato=1,duration=0.5)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[Effect(name="$e_bladeline_01_large", layer = 1)]
[PlaySound(key="$p_atk_knifethrow_n")]
[Blocker(a=0.3, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$p_atk_knifethrow_n")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_magic_5")]
[PlaySound(key="$bottlebroken")]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0.7, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$p_aoe_nmag_h")]
[delay(time=2)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="萨卢斯"]唔！
[playMusic(intro="$exciting_intro", key="$exciting_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]奇美拉，你还有什么血脉没有触及过？展现给我看。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]你能多少次将血收回身体，你又能多少次晓谕自己的命运？
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

[name="Mon3tr"]（疑惑的低吼）
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$char_Mon3tr")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]（愤怒的嘶吼）
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10002",focus="m")]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$Mon3tr_n")]
[name="Mon3tr"]（兴奋的高鸣）
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]你对于这个小怪物的模仿很拙劣。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]是新生后的你实力大不如前，还是众魔敬爱的凯尔希勋爵比想象中受伤更深？
[charslot(slot="m",name="npc_10003_1",focus="m")]
[PlaySound(key="$Mon3tr_n")]
[name="Mon3tr？"]（不屑的咆哮）
[Dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_humanchange")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=2)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="变形者集群"]奎萨图什塔。另一部分，选择了你们。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]你们会带给他什么？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]奎萨图什塔的名讳即是答案。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]（古老的萨卡兹语）“不灭的希望”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]奎萨辛娜，囚笼的意识已经苏醒，继续把她留在你的身边，她只会如同清晨的露珠……蒸发，凋亡。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]我会带走她，我会帮你维持，我会帮你弥补——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]我会把囚笼铸成王冠。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]然后，你会是，我们会是——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_654_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="赦罪师"]永恒的魔王。
[dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_blood")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=1,g=0.2, b=0.2, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=1,g=0.2, b=0.2, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=1,g=0.2, b=0.2, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=1,g=0.2, b=0.2, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0,g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=false)]
[delay(time=1)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[Charslot(duration=2)]
[delay(time=3)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]不要追赶，没有意义。
[playMusic(intro="$mist_intro", key="$mist_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]马上清点损失，准备转移，伤员们的情况还不稳定，但这里已经暴露了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]凯尔希医生。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]干员夜莺是罗德岛医疗部的一员，对于她的挟持和伤害不会被我们允许。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]但任何轻率的举动都可能让她陷入更大的危险，毕竟我们需要面对的对手……是一位觊觎了王冠数千年的，不灭的“魔王”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]奎萨图什塔。叩捶门扉者，篡王之王。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]我留意到了赦罪师的威胁，即使在巴别塔时期，数次举措皆徒劳无功。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]特雷西斯把他们掩饰得很好，让人们以为他们只是摄政王的近卫。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]……请不用担心，我知道我们现在该做什么。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]你比我想象中冷静。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]你们有什么计划？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]丽兹她……自己做出了选择。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]即使是我也从来不敢想的一个选择，大胆，冒进，但却是最有效的手段。看来害怕失去、害怕死亡的始终是我……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]我要做的，呵。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_147_shining_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="闪灵"]是追上她。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……我相信你们。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]阿斯卡纶，阿米娅呢？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]阿米娅和博士也同样遭遇了赦罪师的袭击，现在他们和Logos在一起。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]阿米娅被某种巫术影响了，那个叫萨卢斯的人试图直接夺取魔王的力量，她失败了，但阿米娅现在的状态……很奇怪。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]她陷入了昏迷。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……阿米娅与“魔王”的联系正在加强，我们只能相信她。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]还有些额外情报，我们在战场上发现了数座血魔的法阵，还伴随着一些来自历史的“幻象”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_395_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿斯卡纶"]博士提到了，建造法阵的源石结晶，很“特殊”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]“特殊”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]至于您，变形者阁下，感谢您这次的援助，您想从我们这里索求什么？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]我们索求变化。索求砥砺。索求意义。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]为漫长无序的生命寻找意义。你们展示给我们，我们去证明。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_426_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="变形者集群"]……就这样。
[dialog]
[Charslot(duration=2)]
[delay(time=3)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]通知可露希尔和费斯特，把这里彻底清理干净，我们三小时后出发。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]给W留个讯息，按原定计划，前往布伦特伍德。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]我们……确实要抓紧时间了。
